answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital to validate transactions. In this digital orchard of value, the weight of a signal is directly proportional to the staked asset, ensuring that an attacker cannot scale fake identities without incurring prohibitive financial costs. Like a willow bending under market pressure, the network maintains stability by forcing adversaries to risk their own capital to gain influence, rendering Sybil attacks economically irrational.
